messages:

Subject: Post-demo recap + procurement path for Bluehaven — PO vs card constraints

Ellen / Rajiv — great to meet today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so procurement can pick a route that fits Bluehaven's AP rules.

Demo highlights (2/3):
- Redwood can be live for a pilot within 2 weeks for a single model slice.
- Two commercial paths we usually see: Standard PO (invoice after contract/signature) or Corporate Card (for pilots, faster onboarding).
- Marketplace option (AWS Marketplace) can dramatically shorten vendor onboarding for some procurement teams.

Procurement questions we'd like to confirm so we can scope paperwork and timeline:
1) Preferred payment method for pilots < $10k: Card or PO?
2) Vendor onboarding: do you require a full vendor form, W-9, and tax docs?
3) Security questionnaire: will IT/Security own that workstream and is there a standard intake form?
4) Timing: target date when finance needs an invoice/PO.

Attachments: Bluehaven_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan — draft)

Proposed next steps:
- If PO: we can send a short SOW + standard Redwood PO invoice template, target signature + PO within 7–14 days.
- If Card: we can issue an invoice for the pilot amount and start once card is authorized (usually 1–3 business days).
- If Marketplace: we can route through AWS Marketplace; need to confirm whether Bluehaven prefers that path (we'll provide listing details).

I attached a draft MAP to align responsibilities. If you want, I can attach the SOW and W-9 right now — happy to send both to procurement.

Best,
Lauren Bishop

> Ellen / Rajiv — great to meet today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so procurement can pick a route that fits Bluehaven's AP rules.
> 
> Demo highlights (2/3):

Thanks Lauren — that was helpful. A few answers and follow-ups from procurement: 

1) Payment gates: Our policy historically prefers PO for anything >= $5k. Cards are acceptable for one-off pilots under $5k, but require manager approval.
2) Vendor onboarding: We need a signed W-9, vendor profile form (I will attach the PDF to this thread), and the vendor taxonomy to be completed in Coupa — our AP team will trigger that.
3) Security: IT security will triage the questionnaire; they may ask for SOC2 or equivalent evidence. Expect that to take 5–10 business days depending on scope.
4) Pricing docs: please send SOW + line-item pricing and any applicable discounts.

If you can send the SOW + W-9 and a concise pricing table, we'll route to our finance and security tracks simultaneously. Target internal cutover: we'd like to decide payment method by Dec 10 if possible.

Ellen Park
Director, Procurement | Bluehaven Systems

Ellen — thanks for the details and the vendor form. Sending the items you requested and a few clarifications below.

Summary of commercial paths (to confirm):
- Option A — Standard PO (recommended for production):
  * Timeline: contract + SOW signed → Bluehaven issues PO → Redwood invoices at net 30 unless you prefer net 45.
  * Docs: SOW, Redwood master services agreement (MSA), W-9, and invoice template.
- Option B — Corporate Card (recommended for a lightweight pilot):
  * Timeline: card authorization → we assign pilot capacity and invoice for the card charge.
  * Docs: lightweight SOW, pricing table.
- Option C — AWS Marketplace (if procurement prefers marketplace):
  * Timeline: depends on whether you need marketplace procurement flow; can eliminate some vendor onboarding steps.
  * Note: marketplace billing runs on AWS terms.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (scope for pilot), Redwood_W9.pdf, Redwood_Pricing_Sheet.xlsx. I also uploaded the MAP to the shared drive (link below) for the org owners you mentioned.

Action items for Bluehaven:
1) Confirm preferred route (PO / Card / Marketplace) by EOD Dec 8 to hit your internal Dec 10 decision target.
2) If PO: send the vendor form back with your Coupa vendor name and any PO number rules.
3) If Card: confirm approver and card limits for pilot charges.

Shared MAP link: https://redwoodcrm.example.com/deal/DL-2026-1009-BHVN/map

If you'd like, Marcus (copied) can draft the minimal MSA language for quick signature — Marcus, can you drop a 1‑page MSA + invoice template into this thread?

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.
